title: Knights of Deception
story: In the shadows of the ancient Gothic mansion, crime struck on a dense foggy night. Lady Adeline, the enigmatic owner, lay dead in her study. This night, four knights faced a challenge to prove their innocence.
victim: Lady Adeline, wealthy socialite and owner of the mansion.
crimeScene:
The study was dimly lit, filled with priceless artifacts and an imposing marble fireplace.
Dead body of Lady Adeline, with a vintage pocket watch placed beside her. A note read: 'Payback for betrayal'.
forensicClue: The pocket watch found next to the victim's body has a secret mechanism that sets off an alarm if tampered with.
question: Who committed the crime and how were they linked to Lady Adeline? Uncover the true culprit by examining the suspects' alibis and the hidden clue.

options.option: Colonel Ezra (Found a rare artifact for Lady Adeline)
options.alibi: Enters the mansion at 8 PM, searches for the artifact, leaves at 10 PM, and meets Lady Adeline briefly for a thankful word.
options.alibiReason: Colonel Ezra claims he was searching for a valuable artifact requested by Lady Adeline and only exchanged brief words with her.

options.option: Countess Vivienne (Gave Lady Adeline a potion)
options.alibi: Arrives at 9 PM, presents Lady Adeline with a mysterious potion, leaves at 11 PM, and stops by a tavern.
options.alibiReason: Countess Vivienne visited Lady Adeline to share a peculiar potion and later stopped by a tavern.

options.alibi: Greets Lady Adeline at 10 PM, hosts a secret meeting till midnight, and leaves quietly.
options.alibiReason: Marquess Xavier claimed to have greeted Lady Adeline, organized a secret meeting, and left discreetly.

options.alibi: Pays a debt to Lady Adeline at 9 PM, attends a private dinner at 10 PM, and leaves at midnight.
options.alibiReason: Archduke Felix settled a financial dispute with Lady Adeline, dined at a private dinner, and departed at midnight.

correctReason: Marquess Xavier's secret meeting and discreet departure provide a crucial connection to the crime.
